report.summary:
Patient P-D009 (age 73, Medicare Advantage Lakeshore Senior PPO, home tract 17031720500) was screened 2026-10-19: transportation need = "no", utilities shutoff risk = "no". Today's visit V-D009 included a kept cardiology appointment (appt:1, 10:30). Tract profile: very low no-vehicle share (0.004), 26 transit stops within 800m all with early service. Transit feasibility could not be computed because the cardiology clinic has no facility location on file (get_transit_trip returned an error). No resource-eligibility forms were submitted (H3 pre-application would need the patient's name/address/account/income, which were not provided).

Utilities options:
- Neighborhood Energy Help (fictional): income-based help with gas and electric bills; apply in person Mon/Wed.
- Shutoff Prevention Clinic (fictional): walk-in help with disconnection notices, Tuesdays.
- Utility assistance pre-application (fictional): form posts to check what the patient qualifies for; response within one business day. Requires full name, home address, account number, household income.

Transport options:
- Senior Shuttle West (fictional): free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM — patient is 73, so age-eligible.
- Medicaid Ride Line (fictional): for Medicaid plan members; call the number on the card ≥2 business days ahead. Patient has Medicare Advantage, so Medicaid eligibility is uncertain.
- Paratransit Info Desk (fictional): apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days.
